opening_source_note: jungfrau.ch 2026/27 pass validity; 2025/26 start per Jungfraubahn statement (plattformj)
piste_km_basis: Jungfrau Ski Region pass (only pass sold); Grindelwald-Wengen 101 + First 49 km
score_notes: No FWT/FWQ history and a piste-oriented region, but real off-piste at First (Baergelegg/Schwarzhorn side) and Eigergletscher-Wixi; touring per rubric example: Jungfraujoch railway gives access to Moench/Jungfrau/Loetschenluecke-Konkordia glacier classics plus Faulhorn/Schwarzhorn day tours, strong guide scene (Grindelwald Sports/Bergsteigerzentrum).
comments: Fixed prices, no dynamic pricing: 2025/26 day pass CHF 79 regular, CHF 83 high season (20.12.2025-04.01.2026 and 31.01-01.03.2026); 2026/27 pass published as from CHF 79, high-season surcharge not yet published; season 21.11.2026-25.04.2027. 2025/26: planned weekend start Kleine Scheidegg 15.11.2025 snow permitting (not confirmed), continuous operation from 29.11.2025, Maennlichen 13.12, First 20.12.2025. Max elevation 2500 m = First/Oberjoch per skiresort.com (Kleine Scheidegg-Maennlichen sector 2400 m). Base = Grindelwald Terminal (Eiger Express/Maennlichen gondolas, car park). Route from Milan via Simplon or Gotthard-Interlaken, no winter pass closure on route.

opening_source_note: jungfrau.ch 2026/27 pass validity; 2025/26 start per Jungfraubahn statement (plattformj)
piste_km_basis: Jungfrau Ski Region pass (only pass sold); Grindelwald-Wengen sector 101 km
score_notes: Mainly on-piste intermediate terrain (Lauberhorn/Maennlichen), limited off-piste around Wixi-Fallboden and Eigergletscher, no freeride event history; touring benefits from the Jungfraujoch railway (Moench, Loetschenluecke, Konkordia) and Lauterbrunnen-valley tours but the guide scene sits in Grindelwald/Lauterbrunnen.
comments: Car-free village: road head Lauterbrunnen (multi-storey car park at the station, then WAB rack railway to Wengen). Same Jungfrau Ski Region pass and fixed prices as Grindelwald (CHF 79 regular / 83 high season 2025/26; 2026/27 from CHF 79). Max elevation 2400 m per skiresort.com, not confirmed on official site. Season 2026/27 21.11.2026-25.04.2027.

opening_source_note: 2025/26 plattformj 29.10.2025 + official price list; 2026/27 skiresort.com season entry
piste_km_basis: Jungfrau Ski Region pass (only pass sold); Mürren-Schilthorn sector 54 km
score_notes: Steep, high-vertical off-piste from Schilthorn/Birg (Engetal couloirs, Kanonenrohr, Blumental, Schilthorn north-side itineraries) and the Inferno race heritage, but no FWT/FWQ venue history; touring: Sefinenfurgge, Rottal, Tschingelhorn/Petersgrat and Bluemlisalp-hut classics from Stechelberg/Muerren with Lauterbrunnen-valley guides.
comments: Car-free: road head Stechelberg (Schilthornbahn valley station, direct cable car to Muerren; alternative Lauterbrunnen via BLM cable car + train, both with car parks). 2025/26: weekend-only skiing 1/2, 8/9, 15/16 Nov 2025 (Muerren-Birg cable car, Riggli chair, Engetal pistes), continuous from 22.11.2025 to 26.04.2026. 2026/27 date 07.11.2026 is from skiresort.com (official jungfrau.ch pass validity starts 21.11.2026) - verify with Schilthornbahn. Fixed prices as Jungfrau Ski Region (CHF 79/83 high season 2025/26; pass valid uphill only on Muerren-Schilthorn top section). Schilthorn summit closed during 2025 cable-car rebuild, final new section opened 02.04.2026.

opening_source_note: official operating-hours page (2026/27); 2025/26 planned date via skiinfo, actual not verified
piste_km_basis: Meiringen-Hasliberg local day pass
score_notes: Family/intermediate area with only minor off-piste below Glogghues/Planplatten and no freeride event history; local touring is modest (Hasliberg ridges), the Haslital classics (Rosenlaui, Gadmen/Susten) lie outside the resort.
comments: Fixed price: adult 1-day CHF 65 (official 2025/26 tariff table still online); Magic Pass member since May 2025. 2026/27: continuous operation Sat 19.12.2026-29.03.2027, weekend operation from November possible snow permitting. Base = Hasliberg Twing/Wasserwendi (Kaeserstatt gondola, company HQ, car park); alternative base Meiringen (aerial cableway to Reuti). Route from Milan via Gotthard-Bruenig or Interlaken; Grimsel and Susten passes closed in winter (not required).

ski_area: Gstaad Mountain Rides (Saanenland: Rinderberg-Saanersloch-Horneggli, Eggli-La Videmanette, Wispile, Wasserngrat)
opening_source_note: 2025/26 Gstaad Saanenland Tourismus press release 28.11.2025; 2026/27 skiresort.com season entry
piste_km_basis: Gstaad region total incl. Glacier 3000; 1-day pass excludes Glacier 3000 (31 km)
score_notes: Low, gentle terrain (mostly below 2200 m) with limited off-piste (Videmanette, Wasserngrat) and no freeride event history; touring is pleasant but moderate: Wispile, Hornfluh, Lauenen/Wildhorn hut and Gsteig/Sanetsch tours, Glacier 3000 approaches, local guide offices.
comments: 2025/26: first lifts (Saanersloch-Hornberg) opened 28.11.2025, full operation reached by 20.12.2025; Glacier 3000 (Les Diablerets, 3016 m) opened 08.11.2025 but is NOT included in the 1-day Gstaad ticket (included in multi-day tickets, separate day ticket sold). Max elevation 2151 m = La Videmanette (Rougemont), Rinderberg/Saanersloch sector tops at 2011 m. Pricing: from 2026/27 day tickets have fixed seasonal prices (dynamic pricing dropped for day/half-day tickets, kept for multi-day); CHF 94 = skiresort.com main-season 2026/27 figure, official price table only inside the ticketcorner shop (2026/27 group day ticket CHF 76 for 10+ pax) - verify. Magic Pass partner since 2025/26. Base = Gstaad Eggli gondola valley station car park. Route from Milan via Simplon-Montreux-Col des Mosses or Bern-Zweisimmen; no winter pass closure.

ski_area: Adelboden–Lenk (Chuenisbärgli/Silleren/Hahnenmoos/Metsch; pass incl. Betelberg, Engstligenalp, Elsigen-Metsch, Tschentenalp)
opening_source_note: 2025/26 Nau.ch 28.11.2025 headline (opening pulled forward to 29/30.11); 2026/27 skiresort.com
piste_km_basis: Adelboden-Lenk linked area (skiresort.com); day ticket also covers 4 further areas
score_notes: World Cup piste resort, mostly groomed intermediate terrain with modest off-piste (Luegli, Hahnenmoos, Engstligenalp bowls) and no freeride event history; touring is good but local: Engstligenalp is a classic base (Wildstrubel, Ammertenspitz, Lohner), Sillerenbuehl/Hahnenmoos tours, Adelboden mountain-guide school.
comments: Dynamic pricing for day tickets since 2023/24 (official FAQ: the earlier you book the cheaper); no public price table for 2025/26 or 2026/27 found (webshop only, summer tariffs displayed in Sept) - price left blank, coordinator should check the webshop (peak window). 2025/26: official operating plan started 06.12.2025 (Sillerenbuehl/Metsch) but press (Nau 28.11.2025) reports an earlier opening for the weekend 29/30.11.2025 - verify exact first day. Day ticket 'Adelboden-Lenk incl. Frutigen' covers Adelboden-Lenk, Betelberg, Engstligenalp (top 2353 m), Elsigen-Metsch and Tschentenalp. AlpsPass season pass CHF 949 (2026/27). Base = Oey (Sillerenbahn valley station, car park). Route from Milan via Simplon-Loetschberg car train (Goppenstein-Kandersteg) or Bern-Frutigen; no pass closures.

opening_source_note: 2025/26 Nau.ch 28.11.2025 headline (opening pulled forward to 29/30.11); 2026/27 skiresort.com
piste_km_basis: Adelboden-Lenk linked area (skiresort.com); day ticket also covers Betelberg etc.
score_notes: Metsch/Hahnenmoos and Betelberg are groomed family terrain with little steep off-piste and no freeride event history; touring from Lenk is a real plus (Iffigenalp-Wildhorn, Wildstrubel/Laemmerenhuette, Betelberg-Rothorn day tours) but with limited variety compared with hubs.
comments: Same lift company and dynamic pricing as Adelboden (no public 2025/26 or 2026/27 day-ticket price found - blank, check webshop). Same official 2025/26 plan (06.12.2025) and press-reported earlier weekend opening 29/30.11.2025 (Silleren/Metsch) - verify. Base = Metschbahn valley station Rotenbach (Lenk-Metsch gondola into the linked area, car park); Betelberg is a separate sector at Lenk village on the same pass. Route from Milan via Simplon-Loetschberg car train-Spiez-Zweisimmen or via Bern; no pass closures (Jaunpass open but not needed).

opening_source_note: 2025/26 bergfex season 11.10.2025-03.05.2026 + Obwaldner Zeitung 02.10.2025; 2026/27 skiresort.com
piste_km_basis: Engelberg-Titlis destination pass (bergfex/official 82 km; skiresort.com 70 km Titlis sector)
score_notes: Rubric example for both: Laub, Galtiberg and Steinberg glacier descents with 2000 m vertical, freeride guiding scene (Engelberg Mountain Guide, FWQ history); touring hub with Titlis, Sustenhorn, Jochpass/Engstlen, Spannort and Trift huts and strong guide culture.
comments: Glacier autumn operation: Titlis glacier skiing opened 11.10.2025 (bergfex season data and regional press announcement; Blick 22.10.2025 lists Titlis among open areas); winter 2026/27 published start 10.10.2026 to 02.05.2027. Dynamic online pricing for the destination ski pass ('book early and reap the rewards'); titlis.ch blocks automated access (HTTP 429) and engelberg.ch only lists sub-area prices (Brunni day ticket CHF 48), so the adult peak day price is left blank - check titlis.ch shop. Titlis Rotair closed for maintenance 03-14.11.2025. Base = Titlis Xpress valley station Engelberg (car park). Route from Milan via Gotthard road tunnel-Stans-Engelberg, no pass closures.

opening_source_note: 2026/27 skiresort.com Gemsstock season entry; 2025/26 first day not found
piste_km_basis: SkiArena Andermatt-Sedrun-Disentis pass (resort claim ~180 km; skiresort sectors 31+70+60 km)
score_notes: Rubric example: Gemsstock is a top-tier lift-served freeride mountain (Guspis, Felsental, Giraffe, Sonnenpiste variants) with strong guiding scene and FWQ/Open Faces history; touring hub of the Gotthard/Urseren region (Pizzo Centrale, Piz Badus, Maighels and Vermigel huts, Winterluecke-Realp classics) with deep guide culture.
comments: Dynamic pricing: day-pass prices set daily (weekday, booking date, weather); CHF 89 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 list also 89), official 2025/26 peak range not published as a table - dynamic pricing. 2025/26 Gemsstock first ski day not found (Urner Zeitung reports season-opening event 09.12.2025; regional press indicates Central Swiss resorts started ~22.11.2025) - verify. Oberalp pass closed in winter (Andermatt-Sedrun link by ski/train only, car train not counted); from Milan via Gotthard road tunnel and Schoellenen road (open). Base = Andermatt railway station / Guetsch-Express valley station car parks; Gemsstock cable car 500 m away.

opening_source_note: 2026/27 skiresort.com Andermatt/Oberalp/Sedrun season entry; 2025/26 not found
piste_km_basis: SkiArena pass (~180 km claim); Andermatt-Oberalp-Sedrun sector 70 km, Gemsstock 2961 m on same pass
score_notes: Sedrun side (Cuolm Val, Schneehueenerstock, Oberalp) offers good but moderate lift-accessed off-piste, the serious freeriding is on Gemsstock at the other end of the pass; touring is strong around the Oberalp pass (Piz Badus, Pazolastock, Maighels hut, Val Maighels/Val Cornera classics) with reliable snow.
comments: Same SkiArena pass and dynamic pricing as Andermatt (CHF 89 skiresort.com main-season figure). 2025/26 first ski day for the Sedrun sector not found - verify. Access from Milan: Oberalp and Lukmanier passes closed in winter - route via San Bernardino-Chur-Reichenau-Ilanz-Disentis-Sedrun; Andermatt-Sedrun Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn car train exists but not counted. Base = Dieni (gondola Dieni-Milez valley station next to Dieni railway station, car park).

opening_source_note: 2026/27 skiresort.com Disentis season entry; 2025/26 not found
piste_km_basis: Disentis local day ticket (skiresort.com); SkiArena pass (180 km) also sold
score_notes: Rubric example: Disentis (Pez Ault, Lai Alv, Gendusas couloirs) has FWQ history and a strong freeride reputation for its steep north-facing terrain; touring: Val Medel/Cavardiras and Medelser huts, Piz Ault, Oberalpstock, Lukmanier tours - many documented day tours and a good base.
comments: Disentis sells a local day ticket (CHF 64 adult main season per skiresort.com) besides the dynamic SkiArena Andermatt-Sedrun-Disentis pass (~CHF 89); check which the coordinator wants. 2025/26 first ski day not found - verify. Lukmanier pass closed in winter (treat as closed) - from Milan via San Bernardino-Chur-Ilanz-Disentis. Base = Disentis-Sax/Acletta gondola valley station (coordinates approximate, street geocode of Via Acletta). disentis3000.ch not reachable during research (SSL/timeout).

opening_source_note: 2025/26 Linth24 21.11.2025 / Vaterland 20.11.2025 headlines (earlier weekend start); 2026/27 not fixed
piste_km_basis: Flumserberg local day pass (skiresort.com)
score_notes: Mainly groomed family/intermediate resort with a few short off-piste variants below Leist/Maschgenkamm and no freeride event history; touring is decent locally (Spitzmeilen hut, Wissmilen, Magerrain tours from Tannenboden/Prodkamm) but limited variety.
comments: 2025/26: press headlines (Linth24 21.11.2025 'Flumserberg startet Wintersaison', Vaterland 20.11.2025 'Pizol und Flumserberg starten frueher') indicate a start on the weekend of 22.11.2025 (exact first day 21 or 22.11 - verify). 2026/27: official page says start is flexible, expected late November/early December, season ends 29.03.2027 (skiresort.com placeholder 16.11.2026 not used). Price CHF 74 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 listed 68); official tariff page loads prices dynamically - verify. SeeJet gondola (Unterterzen) closed for revision 30.03-11.06.2027. Base = Tannenboden (Tannenbodenalp, Maschgenkamm gondola, car parks; road open). Route from Milan via Gotthard-Zurich-A3 or San Bernardino-Chur-A13/A3; no pass closures.

opening_source_note: official news 19.11.2025 (November-high weekend skiing on Hoernli); 2026/27 official operating-hours page (daily from 28.11.2026)
piste_km_basis: Arosa Lenzerheide linked ski area pass (official 225 km)
score_notes: Good but not famous lift-accessed off-piste (Weisshorn, Hoernli, Urdenfuerggli/Urdental itineraries) without FWT/FWQ history; touring is solid locally (Aroser Rothorn, Erzhorn, Schiesshorn, Furcletta-Arosa classics) but less varied than the big hubs.
comments: 2025/26: first skiing on the Arosa Hoernli during the 'November high' weekend 22/23.11.2025, daily operation of the whole resort from 29.11.2025 (official news). 2026/27: weekend 'November Bonus Days' possible from 24.10.2026 weather permitting, daily winter pre-season from 28.11.2026, peak season 19.12.2026-11.03.2027 (skiresort.com lists 07.11.2026). Dynamic pricing ('the earlier you book, the lower your price'); CHF 89 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 also 89), official peak range not published as a table. Base = Arosa railway station / Weisshornbahn valley station car park; Arosa road from Chur open all winter. Route from Milan via San Bernardino tunnel-Chur-Arosa.

opening_source_note: official news 26.11.2025 (daily operation from 29/30.11.2025); 2026/27 official operating-hours page
piste_km_basis: Arosa Lenzerheide linked ski area pass (official 225 km)
score_notes: Rothorn and Staetzerhorn offer good but moderate off-piste, no FWT/FWQ history (World Cup and MTB venue instead); touring: Lenzerhorn, Piz Scalottas, Parpaner Rothorn and Staetzerhorn day tours, decent snow but limited alpine scale.
comments: 2025/26: the November-high weekend (22/23.11.2025) skiing was on the Arosa Hoernli side only; Lenzerheide lifts started with the daily operation on 29.11.2025 (official news) - if the Rothorn also ran on 22/23.11 the date would move. 2026/27 published: daily winter operation from 28.11.2026 (weekend bonus days from 24.10.2026 weather permitting), season to 11.04.2027. Same dynamic pricing and CHF 89 list figure as Arosa. Base = Rothornbahn valley station Lenzerheide (car park). Route from Milan via San Bernardino-Chur-Lenzerheide or Julier-Tiefencastel-Lenzerheide (both open).

opening_source_note: 2026/27 skiresort.com season entry; 2025/26 first day not found
piste_km_basis: LAAX pass; skiresort.com 176 km pistes + 40 km ski routes (bergfex/resort 214 km)
score_notes: Large-resort freeride with marked freeride routes and big terrain (Cassons, Vorab glacier, La Siala, Grauberg), freeride-camp and FWQ history, world-class freestyle rather than steep big-mountain; touring is good but secondary (Vorab/Piz Segnas, Flimserstein, Ringelspitz side).
comments: Vorab glacier allows an autumn start (typically late Oct/early Nov) but the actual 2025/26 first ski day was not found in official news or press - verify. Dynamic pricing (bergfex/laax.com: 'dynamic, depending on the day'); range CHF 55-89 taken from skiinfo (2024/25 data: prices vary 55-82 CHF, list max 89, cheaper via INSIDE LAAX app) - 2025/26 official peak range not retrieved. Flims/Falera villages are alternative bases; base used = Laax Murschetg valley station (main car park). Route from Milan via San Bernardino tunnel-Reichenau-Flims-Laax, no pass closure.

ski_area: Engadin St. Moritz (Corviglia–Piz Nair; regional Engadin pass)
opening_source_note: 2026/27 skiresort.com Corviglia season entry; 2025/26 first day not found
piste_km_basis: Corviglia sector (official mountains.ch 155 km); Engadin St. Moritz pass covers all Upper Engadin areas
score_notes: Corviglia/Piz Nair is mainly a groomed piste mountain with some off-piste (Piz Nair north side, Suvretta) - the serious freeriding is on Corvatsch/Diavolezza on the same pass; touring per rubric example 4.0 (Piz Nair, Piz Julier, Suvretta/Piz Bever tours, Bernina classics nearby, many guides).
comments: Engadin St. Moritz regional ski pass shared with Corvatsch, Diavolezza-Lagalb, Zuoz, Zernez etc. (Snow-Deal dynamic pricing: day/multi-day passes 'from CHF 55'; hotel Sleep+Ski pass fixed CHF 55/day; peak day price not published - only the entry price is given, max left blank). 2025/26 Corviglia first ski day not found (Corviglia normally opens late November; Diavolezza on the same pass opened 18.10.2025) - verify. Base = Signalbahn valley station St. Moritz Bad (Signal car park); alternative Chantarella funicular in St. Moritz Dorf. Route from Milan via Chiavenna-Maloja (open) or Tirano-Bernina (open); Julier open, Albula road closed in winter.

ski_area: Engadin St. Moritz (Corvatsch–Furtschellas; regional Engadin pass)
opening_source_note: 2025/26 Corvatsch AG press release 19.11.2025 (Presseportal): season start Sat 22.11.2025; 2026/27 skiresort.com
piste_km_basis: Corvatsch-Furtschellas sector (skiresort.com); Engadin St. Moritz pass covers all Upper Engadin areas
score_notes: Strong glacier-based freeride from the 3303 m summit (Corvatsch glacier descents, Fuorcla Surlej, Hahnensee itinerary, 'big-mountain feel' per skiresort.com) with local guiding but no FWT stop; touring per rubric example (Sils/Bernina 4.5): Piz Corvatsch, Fuorcla Surlej-Roseg, Piz Fora/Val Fex, Coaz and Tschierva huts.
comments: Official press release 'Sportberg Corvatsch eroeffnet Wintersaison' (19.11.2025): 'Am kommenden Samstag, 22. November 2025, startet der Corvatsch in die Skisaison' (Corvatsch Snow Night, Superpipe). Same Engadin regional pass and Snow-Deal dynamic pricing as St. Moritz ('from CHF 55', peak price not published). Base = Corvatsch cable-car valley station Surlej (Silvaplana), large car park; Furtschellas base at Sils. Route from Milan via Chiavenna-Maloja (open, Surlej is 10 min from Maloja side) or Bernina pass; Julier open.

ski_area: Engadin St. Moritz (Val Bernina: Diavolezza–Lagalb; regional Engadin pass)
opening_source_note: 2025/26 Engadiner Post 18.10.2025 'Diavolezza startet in die Wintersaison' + Presseportal 15.10.2025; 2026/27 skiresort.com
piste_km_basis: Diavolezza-Lagalb sector (skiresort.com); Engadin St. Moritz pass covers all Upper Engadin areas
score_notes: Glacier freeride classic: 10 km Diavolezza-Morteratsch glacier run (longest secured glacier descent in CH), steep Lagalb faces and 10 km of marked ski routes, guiding via Pontresina; touring per rubric example (Bernina 4.5): Piz Palue, Bellavista, Piz Morteratsch, Piz Cambrena, Diavolezza/Boval huts, Bernina pass tours.
comments: Autumn operation: opened for skiing 18.10.2025 as the first Swiss non-glacier-piste ski area (press headlines Engadiner Post 18.10.2025, Presseportal 15.10.2025); skiresort.com season pattern mid-Oct to mid-Nov, then mid-Dec to early May (2026/27: 17.10.2026-02.05.2027). Pistes are on the Diavolezza/Lagalb slopes, the glacier descent is an unprepared marked route - hence Glacier + non-glacier. Engadin regional pass with Snow-Deal dynamic pricing ('from CHF 55', peak not published); a Diavolezza-only ticket may exist (not verified). Base = Diavolezza valley station on the Bernina pass road (car park); Bernina pass kept open in winter, direct route from Milan via Tirano-Poschiavo (Italian side).

opening_source_note: 2026/27 skiresort.com season entry; 2025/26 first day not found
piste_km_basis: Obersaxen Mundaun Val Lumnezia local day pass
score_notes: Sunny, mostly gentle groomed terrain with only short tree-line off-piste and no freeride event history; touring is modest (Piz Mundaun, Piz Sezner, Val Lumnezia easy tours).
comments: Fixed prices: official winter tariff page lists adult day ticket CHF 67 (half-day tiers CHF 65/61/54/48); the table is undated but sits next to 2026/27 season-pass offers (skiresort.com also 67; skiinfo 2024/25 65) - treat as 2026/27. 2025/26 first ski day not found (press 24.12.2025 reported thin snow at mid-altitude Graubuenden resorts) - verify. Base = Meierhof (Obersaxen) valley station, car park; alternative bases Valata and Vella. Route from Milan via San Bernardino-Chur-Ilanz-Obersaxen, no pass closure.

opening_source_note: bergfex resort-supplied operating data (2025/26 season 13.12.2025-06.04.2026; 2026/27 weekend 5/6.12.2026, daily from 12.12.2026)
piste_km_basis: Savognin local pass (bergfex/resort 80 km; skiresort.com 73.5 km)
score_notes: Wide groomed family pistes with a marked freeride area but little steep terrain and no event history; touring around the Surses is good (Piz Mitgel, Piz Arblatsch, Piz Martegnas, Bivio classics nearby) with reliable snow but modest variety.
comments: Dynamic pricing (bergfex/resort: 'dynamic, depending on the day'); no official price range found (skiinfo/skiresort show no figure) - price left blank, check savogninbergbahnen.ch shop. 2025/26 date 13.12.2025 is the planned season start supplied to bergfex, actual not verified. 2026/27: weekend operation Savognin-Piz Martegnas 5/6.12.2026, daily from 12.12.2026, end 29.03.2027. Base = Tigignas 10-seater gondola valley station in Savognin (Veia Riom, car park). Route from Milan via Chiavenna-Maloja-Silvaplana-Julier pass-Bivio-Savognin (Maloja and Julier open in winter) or via Chur-Tiefencastel.

opening_source_note: 2026/27 official operating-times page (12.12.2026-04.04.2027); 2025/26 not found
piste_km_basis: Scuol Motta Naluns local day pass
score_notes: Motta Naluns has several marked freeride routes and open bowls (Champatsch, Mot da Ri) and a snowboard heritage but no FWT/FWQ history; Lower Engadin touring is good (S-charl, Sesvenna, Piz Nair, Piz Minschun) yet less alpine than the Upper Engadin.
comments: Pricing: fixed prices at the ticket offices, flexible early-booking prices online (official); numeric table not shown on the page - CHF 69 is the skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 also 69). 2025/26 first ski day not found - verify. Base = Motta Naluns gondola valley station next to Scuol-Tarasp railway station (car park). Access from Milan: Flueela pass closed - via Chiavenna-Maloja or Tirano-Bernina to the Engadin then Zernez-Susch-Scuol (Engadin valley road open), or via Austria (Reschen-Landeck-Martina); Ofen pass open.

opening_source_note: 2026/27 official Bergbahnen Samnaun operating page (Thu 26.11.2026-02.05.2027); 2025/26 traditional Thursday start, opening concert 29.11.2025 (press)
piste_km_basis: Silvretta Arena Ischgl-Samnaun pass (only pass sold)
score_notes: Large high-altitude resort with extensive lift-accessed off-piste (Palinkopf, Greitspitz, Piz Val Gronda, Alp Trida side) and a strong local freeride scene but no FWT stop; touring from Samnaun is decent (Muttler, Piz Mundin, Stammerspitz) but secondary to lift skiing.
comments: 2025/26 date is the traditional Ischgl/Samnaun Thursday season start (27.11.2025) inferred from the same-pattern official 2026/27 date and press on the 29.11.2025 opening concert (Rita Ora) - exact first lift day not individually verified. Fixed price published for 2026/27 by Bergbahnen Samnaun: Silvretta Skipass 1 day adult CHF 82 (Ischgl side sells in EUR, 2025/26 EUR 83 per skiresort.com). Duty-free enclave: road access only through Austria (Landeck-Pfunds-Spiss-Samnaun) or from the Engadin via Martina-Vinadi-Spiss; from Milan via Reschen pass (open) or the Engadin. Base = Samnaun-Ravaisch cable-car valley station (Twinliner, car park).

opening_source_note: official news 05.11.2025 (Parsenn opened Fri 07.11.2025, weekends, daily from 21.11.2025); 2026/27 skiresort.com Parsenn entry
piste_km_basis: Davos Klosters regional pass (official 255 km, 5 mountains); Parsenn sector 95.5 km
score_notes: Rubric example (4.0/4.0): Parsenn/Weissfluh long off-piste descents to the Praettigau, Pischa as dedicated freeride mountain, Jakobshorn side-country, historic Parsenn Derby; touring: Fluela and Dischma/Sertig valleys, Fluela Schwarzhorn, Piz Grialetsch, Kesch and Silvretta hut tours - many documented day tours.
comments: 2025/26: Parsenn opened 07.11.2025 (a week earlier than planned, weekends only), continuous operation from 21.11.2025 (official news). Dynamic online pricing (cheaper online/early); CHF 86 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure, official peak range not published as a table. Access from Milan: Flueela pass closed in winter - via the Engadin and the Vereina car train (Sagliains-Klosters) or via San Bernardino-Chur-Landquart-Klosters-Wolfgang (road open). Base = Parsennbahn funicular valley station Davos Dorf (car park); Jakobshorn base at Davos Platz.

opening_source_note: Parsenn shared with Davos: official news 05.11.2025; 2026/27 skiresort.com Parsenn entry (Madrisa 17.12.2026)
piste_km_basis: Davos Klosters regional pass (official 255 km); Madrisa sector 26 km
score_notes: Shares Parsenn with Davos (Gotschnawang/Drostobel and Parsenn descents to Kueblis and Klosters are freeride classics) plus Madrisa off-piste; touring: Silvretta and Vereina huts, Madrisa-Gargellen crossing, Casanna/Weissfluh tours - many documented day tours.
comments: 2025/26 date refers to the shared Parsenn area (opened from the Davos side 07.11.2025, weekends); the Klosters Gotschnabahn may have started later (daily operation from 21.11.2025) - verify. Madrisa (Klosters Dorf) opens later (2026/27: 17.12.2026 per skiresort.com). Same dynamic pricing and CHF 86 list figure as Davos. Base = Gotschnabahn valley station Klosters Platz (railway station, car park). Access from Milan via the Engadin + Vereina car train (Sagliains-Klosters Selfranga) or via Chur-Landquart-Klosters; Flueela closed.

opening_source_note: 2025/26 official vals.ch tickets page (season operation from Sat 20.12.2025, planned); 2026/27 skiresort.com
piste_km_basis: Vals-Dachberg local day pass
score_notes: Small area but the steep, north-facing Dachberg flanks (Leis, Dachberg couloirs) have a cult freeride reputation and near-empty lifts, no event history; the Valser valley is a classic touring destination (Zervreila, Laenta hut, Fanellhorn, Piz Aul, Guraletsch) with good snow but limited lift support.
comments: Included per criterion 4 (top 2851 m) only - small area (25 km, 6 lifts). Input skiresort_url points to Monterosa Ski by mistake; correct page https://www.skiresort.com/en/ski-resort/vals-dachberg/. Fixed price: adult 1-day CHF 39 (official 2025/26 table, juniors under 16 free; skiinfo 18.11.2025 and skiresort.com agree); 2026/27 prices not yet published. 2025/26 date is the official planned season start (20.12.2025-06.04.2026), actual not verified. Base = Vals village (Vals-Gadastatt gondola valley station in the village, coordinates = village centre, approximate). Route from Milan via San Bernardino tunnel-Chur-Ilanz-Vals (Vals road only from Ilanz), no pass closure on the A13 route.
